Exact rational identities, square-root rationalisation, secant values and units, perturbation bounds, tied extrema, cooling rate/MVT witness and shifted-cube explanation checked. iCMA correct choices and every distractor checked against mathematical conditions. fixes: Replaced ambiguous horizontal-inflection wording with a direct comparison of stationary points and the inflection point.
Repaired a Python string escape that had corrupted the not-equal symbol in iCMA feedback.
Separated the reserved 80-minute unit-exercise attempt period from the 60-minute mixed Block 2 period and 45-minute correction allocation.
Kept limits, original functions and continuous extensions explicitly distinct.

reader.judgement: Worked solutions explain the method and invalid inferences rather than only provide answers. Mixed practice combines method selection, hypotheses and an independent check. The checkpoint supports correction, not certification.

visual: Eight standalone width/theme cases and final integrated browser review. Inspected mobile worked example, opened extrema solution, decision diagram and checkpoint feedback. All mathematics semantic MathML; long formulas locally scrollable. PDF two A4 pages rendered and both inspected after footer-spacing correction.
media: One original decision diagram. No additional photograph in the closing lesson: this is synthesis of the three illustrated development lessons, with no new physical instrument or historical claim. Reviewed against the illustrated reference; the original diagram, mixed practice, native feedback and reference table provide appropriate visual structure. No blanket exemption from image standards or duplicate image added for decoration.
workload: 35 synthesis +60 mixed activities +45 correction +60 iCMA (40 attempt/20 feedback) +25 conclusion/reference +15 handover =240 minutes. Twelve unit exercises total80 reserved minutes. No separate lesson-end sets or extra assessment budget.
assessment: Formative iCMA02 has 10 questions, explanatory feedback, keyboard controls and manual no-JS fallback; no persistence, submission, threshold or completion award. TMA02 remains separate6h and unreleased.
disposition: Subject, reader, standalone and integrated reviews passed. This is author self-review and independent recalculation, not external human review or observed learner testing.
